    From an admissible presentation to path data #

    An admissible presentation π : kQ → Λ of the statement gives path data on A = Λᵐᵒᵖ (right Λ-modules are left A-modules): e v = op (π e_v) and α a = op (π a). Path values are op (π (e_x · w)) (pval_eq), they span A (span_pval), the data is admissible (isAdmissible; nonvanishing of vertices and arrows is detected by two small representations of kQ that kill all words of length at least two), and the special biserial conditions transfer (isSpecialBiserial).
